terbaru.judul: Blockchain-Enabled Secure Logging for Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms: Evaluation of the Greek eSEND and myDATA Tax Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper analyzes the implementation of blockchain-based integrity mechanisms in Greek Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms (FEMs) and the central tax information system eSEND.

terbaru.judul: A Black Box for Agentic Processes: Blockchain-Anchored Evidence for AI Agent Communication, Human Oversight, and GRC Audits
terbaru.pelajaran: Autonomous AI agents increasingly communicate with other agents, invoke tools, exchange intermediate results, and request human approvals.

terbaru.judul: Employing the Structural Power to Achieve Supply-Demand Balanced Payment Channel Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: Blockchain technology faces scalability challenges because transactions must be validated and recorded across the network.

terbaru.judul: Population-Calibrated Graph Screening at 835-Million-Address Scale, with Label-Free Transfer to New Chains
terbaru.pelajaran: Compliance screening of blockchain addresses is, in practice, a lookup against sanctions registries plus clustering heuristics; it fails on unlabelled addresses and on chains with no label coverage at all.

terbaru.judul: Bonded Recourse for Smart-Contract Settlement of Compensable Agent Side Effects
terbaru.pelajaran: Autonomous agent runtimes execute tool actions that mutate databases, repositories, and cloud services across organizational boundaries.

terbaru.judul: Agent Flight Recorder: Tamper-Evident Audit Trails with On-Chain Anchoring for Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
terbaru.pelajaran: Long-horizon agents execute thousands of actions, resulting in sequential failures rather than isolated errors.

terbaru.judul: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance
terbaru.pelajaran: This study develops and evaluates Authority-Inference Separation (AIS), an intent-centered architecture for bounded agentic finance.

terbaru.judul: Spec2Twin-Chain: Orchestrating Bi-Level Optimization with LLMs for Blockchain Digital Twin Construction
terbaru.pelajaran: Building a blockchain digital twin largely requires translating domain knowledge and specific system descriptions into a simulator architecture, calibrating its parameters against behavioral evidence, and validating the constructed twin.

terbaru.judul: Relaxed Sender Anonymity for CBDC Interbank Settlement: A Zero-Knowledge Approach on Permissioned EVM
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a confidential interbank settlement protocol for permissioned Ethereum-compatible networks that resolves this tension through a relaxed sender anonymity model tailored to regulatory AML/CFT requirements.

terbaru.judul: When Verified Source Becomes Attack Input: Defending Smart Contracts Against LLM-Based Vulnerability Scanning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose DeLLMGuard, a smart contract deployment framework that defends against malicious LLM-based vulnerability scanning while preserving public source disclosure and authorized auditing.
